text:
Lina K.: Hey team — planning to come back after parental leave but need a flexible ramp: 3 days remote, 2 days onsite for first 8 weeks. Two Qs: does the childcare stipend still apply if I reduce onsite days? Also we hired a temp contractor to cover some work 12 will that affect headcount approvals or benefits eligibility?

Sofia (People Ops): Congrats on the return plan! Short: stipend is tied to 'active leave' status, not onsite days, so if you're off-leave and working reduced schedule the standard childcare stipend won't continue automatically. We can consider a transitional partial stipend in special cases.

Lina K.: Got it. Who approves "transitional partial stipend"?

Marta (Benefits): Hi Lina  benefits team + People Ops evaluate transitional stipends case-by-case. Factors: length of gap since leave ended, financial need, org impact. Submit the "leave amendment" form and put "transitional stipend request" in the notes. We'll review within 5 business days.

Devon (Hiring Ops): On the contractor: we engaged a 3-month contractor to backfill capacity. That doesn't change your benefits eligibility as long as you're still considered a regular employee. From hiring ops side, keep us posted if contractor needs to extend so we can coordinate budget.

Lina K.: If I get a partial stipend, will it be taxable like regular pay?

Marta (Benefits): Yes — any stipend paid outside of paid parental leave will be processed through payroll and taxed accordingly. We'll include a note on the payslip.

Sofia (People Ops): Practical steps: 1) File leave amendment form: https://intranet.redwood/leave/amend 2) Select "Phased return" and add your 3/2 schedule + request for transitional stipend. 3) CC your manager and Marta. 4) We'll coordinate with Devon about coverage overlap.

Lina K.: Timeline: planning to return 2026-06-01. If I file the amendment this week, will payroll handle the stipend for June?

Marta (Benefits): If we get the form by 2026-05-20 we'll make standard payroll cutoff for the June cycle. Later than that may push stipend to July via manual adj.

Devon (Hiring Ops): FYI Lina  contractor Pri is scheduled through 2026-08-15. If your phased return reduces handoff burden, we can wind down early. Happy to sync on a 30-min overlap plan.

Lina K.: Appreciate it. One more: does reduced FTE for the ramp affect my pro-rated vacation accruals and performance review timeline?

Sofia (People Ops): Vacation accrual is pro-rated by FTE during the reduced schedule period. Performance review timeline stays the same (we treat the return date as resuming active employment). If you want a performance checkpoint at the end of the 8-week ramp, ask your manager to schedule a mid-cycle check-in.

Lina K.: Perfect. Filing the form now and cc'ing Maya and Marta. Thanks! :heart:

HiringBot: Note: contractor end date 2026-08-15; budget holder: Eng Ops.

Marta (Benefits): Received the form. We'll review stipend request and confirm within 3 business days.
_notes: Phased return (hybrid 3/2) Qs: childcare stipend continuity, transitional partial stipend approval process, contractor backfill coordination, payroll cutoff, vacation accrual, and performance check-ins. Slack-style short messages, internal form links and deadlines included.
